method: The page renders #storeList server-side. Driven through its own search box (#searchKeyword) with each of the 25 자치구, then again with 중구 landmark keywords because '서울 중구' alone returned nothing. Deduplicated on the store code in getStockStoreDetail('CODE', ...).
note: 'time' is the hours for the day of capture only, not a weekly schedule. 'tags' are the badges the finder shows (e.g. 스마트 반품). Stores whose addr is outside 서울 were dropped.
